vakṛṣṇa, son of Gaṅgādāsa.

भवदेव the author of the Tantravārttikaṭīkā is identical
with Bhavadeva surnamed Bālavalabhībhujaṅga.

भवदेव the author of the Brahmasūtraṭīkā was the son
of Kṛṣṇadeva.

भवदेव मिश्र father of Bhairava Miśra:
 Bṛhacchabdaratnaṭīkā.

composed in 1650:

written by the same.

भवनाथ ठक्कुर of the Goghota family, father of Gopī-
nātha (Tarkabhāṣāṭīkā). Cop. p. 8.

khyā) is said to have written on the same subject.

kāṇḍa.

भवभूति son of Nīlakaṇṭha and Jātūkarṇī, grandson of
Bhaṭṭa Gopāla of Padmapura. He was a contemporary
of Vākpatirāja and lived under Yaśovarman. Rāja-
taraṅgiṇī 4, 144. Verses of his are quoted by
[]
Kṣemendra, in Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa, Bhojapra-
bandha, Śp. p. 63, Skm. Sbhv. Padyāvalī. He wrote:
 Uttararāmacarita.
 Mahāvīracarita.
 Mālatīmādhava.

भवभूति (most probably a nom de plume for Rāmakṛṣṇa),
son of Tirumala, grandson of Veṅkaṭādri, great
grandson of Jagannātha:
 Uttaracarita. Hz.

भवशर्मन् wrote by request of Rāmadatta, minister of
Nṛsiṃhanṛpa of Mithilā:
 Ṣoḍaśamahādānapaddhati. Quoted by Rudra-
dhara in Śrāddhaviveka.
